title: Lemon and Thyme Roast Chicken
key_sentences: This is a Sunday supper that cooks itself while you do something else.
The lemon keeps the meat moist and the thyme perfumes the kitchen.
Pour the lemon juice over the vegetables ten minutes before the end.
Store covered in the fridge and reheat until piping hot.

rows: lemons, one sliced and one juiced

list_items.text: 1. Heat the oven to 200 degrees and let the chicken stand at room temperature for thirty minutes.
2. Rub the butter over the skin and season generously with salt and pepper.
3. Put the lemon slices, garlic and half of the thyme inside the cavity.
4. Toss the vegetables in olive oil and spread them around the bird in a deep tray.
5. Roast for 75 minutes, then rest the chicken for ten minutes before carving.
Pour the lemon juice over the vegetables ten minutes before the end.
A little white wine in the tray makes a quick gravy.
